correctness.rationale: For uniform A in GL_n(F_q), each fixed nonzero x has P(A x^[2]=x)=1/(q^n-1), so EN=1. Distinct nonzero idempotents cannot be scalar multiples. For linearly independent x,y, their prescribed images occur with probability 1/[(q^n-1)(q^n-q)] exactly when x^[2],y^[2] are independent. In even characteristic Frobenius is a field automorphism and all independent pairs qualify, giving Var N=1. For odd q, a vector with s nonzero coordinates has (q-1)2^{s-1} projectively square-colliding y, including q-1 scalar copies; support summation removes B=(q-1)((2q-1)^n-2q^n+1)/2 pairs and yields Var N=1-B/[(q^n-1)(q^n-q)]. n=1 separately has zero variance. Strict 0<Var<1 and deficit asymptotic (2^{n-1}-1)q^{1-n} at fixed n follow. Inspected finite-field arithmetic and matrix-exhaustion verifier verify_moments.py, including extension-field model; independent small q,n enumerations corroborate without replacing proof.
